meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加一个本地监控仪表盘：每 60 秒推送一次数据快照，每 2 秒推送日志，在 http://localhost:3100/dashboard 查看会话、频道、用户、Token 用量和实时日志。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 添加监控面板，或提到 /add-dashboard 时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 装上 dashboard 监控面板
say.note: 会安装依赖并把推送模块写入 src/

say.text: 看看 dashboard 推送有没有报错
say.note: 会去 logs/nanoclaw.log 查推送错误

say.text: 帮我把 dashboard 从 NanoClaw 移除
say.note: 会删推送模块、卸载依赖并清掉 .env 配置

howto.what_en: Adds a local monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw: it pushes a JSON snapshot every 60s and logs every 2s, serving pages for sessions, channels, users, token usage and live logs at localhost:3100/dashboard.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw, or mention /add-dashboard.

say_en.text: Add the monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Installs the package and writes the pusher into src/

say_en.note: Looks for push errors in logs/nanoclaw.log
Deletes pusher files, uninstalls the package, clears .env
